title: Write Testbench for Sign Extender
statement: Write a testbench that exercises a sign extender with positive and negative inputs. The testbench should confirm the extended bits replicate the sign bit correctly. It should print the input and output values for verification.
behavior: Apply examples with positive and negative 8-bit values.
Verify the upper bits match the sign bit.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not modify the DUT interface.
hint: Use both negative and nonnegative examples in the testbench.
